project_info.theme: dreamy long-exposure light painting around a hooded adult man
project_info.color_palette: pale blue, butter yellow, peach pink, soft white

main_subject.detail: An adult Korean man with tousled dark hair, a calm direct expression, and an opaque pale white hoodie pulled over his head.
main_subject.style: intimate fine-art portrait with visible natural skin texture and slight film softness

items: continuous pastel light-painting loops crossing the eye line
small scattered out-of-focus light streaks around the subject
minimal pale blue and yellow background

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: diffused pastel key light at approximately 5600K with controlled long-exposure light trails
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft glow edges, lifted blacks, gentle haze, and a lively but introspective motion feeling

technical_specs.render_style: low-angle portrait on Kodak Portra 400 film, 50mm lens at f/2, visible 35mm grain, natural vignetting, and slight chromatic aberration

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Art photography of an adult Korean man in an opaque pale white hoodie, centered in a chest-up portrait against a minimal pale blue and butter-yellow background. His tousled dark hair escapes from the hood and he holds a calm direct expression. Create strong long-exposure pastel light-painting loops across the eye line and a few soft drifting light streaks around him, with motion blur and a dreamy atmospheric glow. Use a low camera angle, Kodak Portra 400 film characteristics, a 50mm lens at f/2, slightly desaturated pastel color, lifted blacks, visible fine grain, ultra-soft focus, natural skin texture, and subtle glow at the edges. No other person, no readable lettering, portrait 3:4.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, readable text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate subject, harsh neon clipping
